layout: named rectangles; do not divide automatically into equal cells
coordinateConvention: rect [x,y,width,height]; anchor [x,y] relative to rect at base; nominalHeight is visible pixel height. solidRect, when supplied, is a suggested authored collision body [x,y,width,height] relative to rect, excluding decorative leaves.

frames.name: log
frames.role: low platform; moss and leaf tips extend above solid body

frames.name: crate
frames.role: solid wooden box; top leaves are decorative

frames.name: door
frames.role: closed door and stone frame; interaction/opening effect belongs to renderer

frames.name: bell
frames.role: bell in complete wooden support arch

frames.name: spring
frames.role: magical spring flower; renderer supplies compression and rebound

notes: PNG bytes are unchanged from ImageGen. Empty pixels can retain hidden RGB colour while alpha is zero; do not discard alpha when loading or exporting.
Every visible pixel at alpha >= 32 is covered by these rectangles, with eight pixels of clear edge padding.
Object collision bounds are independent from texture padding. Use the authored anchor to align the base; leaves above the log and crate do not define their solid collision top.
Terrain texture is a separate full rectangle; its first row aligns exactly with the collision surface and should never be drawn at an offset fake floor.
